import json, resource, subprocess, sys, time
started = time.time()
result = subprocess.run(sys.argv[2:])
usage = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
fields = ('ru_utime', 'ru_stime', 'ru_maxrss', 'ru_minflt', 'ru_majflt',
          'ru_inblock', 'ru_oublock', 'ru_nvcsw', 'ru_nivcsw')
with open(sys.argv[1], 'x') as stream:
    json.dump(dict(start=started, end=time.time(), returncode=result.returncode,
                   usage={field: getattr(usage, field) for field in fields}), stream)
sys.exit(result.returncode)
